propositions: Serena symbol tool schemas are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before use, creating friction compared to non-deferred tools
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is a global all-or-nothing lever with no per-tool or per-server control; setting it to false loads all connected MCP server schemas at session start
Loading all Serena tool schemas costs a minimum of 25k additional prompt tokens, rising to 64k with multiple connected servers, justifying the defect prevention
The repository needs a tracked .claude/settings.json with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH configured and a .gitignore negation to allow tracking only that file
Per-tool non-deferral is not implementable because Claude Code exposes only the global ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH lever; the original AC of limiting always-loaded tools to <=4 Serena tools is infeasible
